topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I never expected to uncover a part of my own past so unexpectedly. The box was heavy, rusted shut, and nestled deeply in the earth where no rational thought would place such a thing. The realization that I had forgotten the act of burying it is a peculiar weight, one that presses down harder than the soil above it. Inside, the contents are both familiar and alien, a stark reminder of a chapter sealed away, perhaps for a reason. Each item stares back at me, silent witnesses to a history I've tried to move beyond. The air feels thicker, the light dimmer, as if the day itself is hesitating, aware of the secrets now unearthed.
